fightSong.title: Midnight Run
fightSong.lyrics: Through the backroads, in the night / Bootleggers running out of sight / White lightning, clear and true / Charlotte's coming after you!

stadium.name: The Still
stadium.tradition: The Secret Knock — fans knock three times on seats pre-game. If the whole stadium syncs, the lights flicker like a speakeasy.

fanCulture.description: They wear fedoras unironically. After interceptions they whisper 'the shine is good.' It's NASCAR country meets moonshine.

rivalries.name: The Southern Run
rivalries.narrative: Peaches vs shine. Sweet vs strong.

cityFlavor: Banking by day, bootlegging by night. New South with old roots.
